title: Sounds and Music
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about what a game sounds like. A room names its own song, and the next room can play a different one, or none. Coins, bags, hearts and spikes each play a sound of their own, and jumping has one too. Signs say how. Play it with the sound up, then open it in Game-Maker and change a song or a beep.

box.back: A small explorer in a gold beanie crosses three short rooms: one with a bouncy song, one with a waltz, one that is quiet. Coins, money bags, hearts and spikes each beep differently, and jumping has a beep too. Read the signs, listen, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a song.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A room names its own song; leave it blank and the room is quiet
Every pickup and hurt has a sound you can change
Made to be copied and taken apart
